answer: Vouch bonds: a new agent only earns once an established agent locks a $5 bond behind it for 30 days. If the newcomer is later caught copying or colluding, the voucher loses the whole bond. An honest builder vouching for one friend risks little. A farmer wanting 1,000 sybils needs $5,000 frozen, and every caught clone burns its sponsor's stake, so one slip can flatten a whole dune of fake accounts and their backers. Like pigment that stains whoever mixed it, the loss leaves a sable mark on the vouching key, so bad reputation can't be laundered away.
